lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits. Spots are organized into horizontal rows with relatively uniform spacing between neighboring centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of blobs. The highest-intensity blobs are positioned at the intersection points, forming a structural grid pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the mid-to-upper flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient where the upper edge of each ridge reflects light and the lower edge is in shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains numerous small, high-luminance spots. These spots are smaller and more randomly distributed than those on the flank, appearing as discrete points across the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense field of small, high-intensity spots, concentrated most heavily toward the distal edge and anterior margin.
